classification: DERIVED conditional finite-sample stochastic upper envelopes; not exact tail laws

prerequisites.requirement: Fixed known Gaussian joint covariance per frozen scenario, common to all compared models
Same affine support, observation units and density normalizations
True mean and nuisance contained in declared null domains
Fixed X of supported full column rank63, eta in R^63
All actual model means globally contained in declared response span for refined bound
Whitening, quotient and global span recomputed or certified for each scenario
Exact inherited72 covariance constraints if residual df upper148 is used
Certified lower bounds for true global minima, feasible certified upper bounds for competitors
Certified upper numerical SF including theory/rounding errors; no numerical zero tail
Entire frozen scenario family available or proved equivalent coverage, with label mapping
Selection and multiplicity contract held fixed, no new data-dependent route selection
Conditional interpretation of reported or plug-in errors explicitly ratified

base_theorem.uniformity: all admitted true physical parameters and eta; no improper sampling prior

gain_theorem.inclusion: Every R_s[mu_comp(xi)-mu_null(xi0)] belongs to fixed V_s for every pair of allowed parameters
gain_theorem.B17_columns: 16 background coordinate columns plus extended local a_h
gain_theorem.V_s: Range(R_s B17) or Range(R_s B18), with scenario-specific R_s

structural_dimensions.degree_148_guard: Exact72 covariance kernel constraints and supported rank63 X in actual joint matrix

subset_262.scope: Historical conditional engineering subset, not full experiment

test_envelopes.statistic_lower: max(0,L1-U3), only with qualified H1 subset H3

certificates.minima: For every required model, deterministic L_i<=global_inf_RSS_i<=U_i
certificates.local_optimizer_returns: feasible upper U only; never global lower L
certificates.global_lower_option: minimum distance to certified outer enclosures over complete null-domain cell cover
certificates.theory: include entire-domain prediction/support/whitening/roundoff errors, not five-point agreement only
certificates.tail: upper numerical SF, stable at small p; exact/interval error bounds
certificates.probabilistic_certification: Any failure probability must be allocated inside total alpha budget

p_value.zero_dimension: point mass0 with inclusive tail, no generic chi2(df=0)
p_value.robust: max_s p_upper over complete frozen family or certified equivalent coverage
p_value.Z_equivalent_lower: Phi^-1(1-p_familywise_upper), optional, not positive evidence for large p

V2_interoperation.weak_bound: Valid but non-rejecting conservative test, not missing calibration
V2_interoperation.weak_bound_limit: Does not show exact p exceeds alpha; does not validate the model
V2_interoperation.not_falsified: Only both complete valid H1 tests non-reject under V2; power separate
V2_interoperation.incomplete: No robust p/non-rejection from subset of available scenarios
V2_interoperation.bayes: All relative evidence remains separately computed under its own measure contract

extensions_not_adopted.covariance_inflation: If true fixed Gaussian Sigma <= a C_work uniformly, use a*chi2, with justified a and same support
extensions_not_adopted.unknown_or_parameter_dependent_covarianc: No automatic likelihood-ratio extension; fresh proof required
extensions_not_adopted.estimated_covariance: No automatic chi-square pivot even if independent estimate
extensions_not_adopted.full_spectral_CMB: New dimension and theory/likelihood contract needed

alternatives.name: Residual chi-square envelope for all five tests
Residual envelope for G and global-span envelopes for Q/T
Sharper uniformly calibrated tails in a separate future unit
